+The :class:`ensemble.IsolationForest` supports warm starting, which allows
+adding more trees to an already fitted model. This can be useful when more
+estimators are needed to improve the model's performance without retraining
+from scratch. To use warm starting, set ``warm_start=True`` and increase
+``n_estimators`` between calls to ``fit``.
+
 This algorithm is illustrated below.

+@pytest.mark.filterwarnings('ignore:default contamination')
+@pytest.mark.filterwarnings('ignore:behaviour="old"')
+def test_iforest_warm_start():
+    """Test that warm_start adds more estimators to the ensemble."""
+    X = iris.data
+    clf = IsolationForest(n_estimators=10, warm_start=True, random_state=0)
+    clf.fit(X)
+    n_estimators_initial = len(clf.estimators_)
+    assert_equal(n_estimators_initial, 10)
+
+    clf.set_params(n_estimators=20)
+    clf.fit(X)
+    n_estimators_after = len(clf.estimators_)
+    assert_equal(n_estimators_after, 20)
+    assert_greater(n_estimators_after, n_estimators_initial)
+
+
